note: The machine-readable manual accessibility qualification record, enforced by tools/ci/validate-accessibility-qualification.mjs as a release gate (workflows/release.yml). Scope is desktop: NVDA + Chrome (Windows), NVDA + Firefox (Windows), VoiceOver + Safari (macOS) and one speech-recognition or switch-access pass. Every required row must be status "pass" with a fresh tested_at and complete evidence: exact browser and assistive-technology versions (placeholders rejected), zoom_percent 200 (the actual release zoom run), keyboard/live_region/focus/content_loss observations all "pass", and asset_identity equal to the current canonical client asset digest (the release artifact identity, not a commit string). No physical mobile device appears in this gate. Rows: status manual_pending | pass | fail | blocked; required rows are exactly the four ids below and are release-blocking until they pass.
